title: JANUS Linear A SigLA source-native word-unit reference contract

fragment_hypothesis_audit.interpretation: The initial href-fragment hypothesis was rejected rather than repaired posthoc.

scope.source: SigLA — The Signs of Linear A
applies_only_when: the frozen SigLA source-adapter contract passes
the word-view page has exactly one document-view container
the page is capability-positive with source-native span.popup.word and SVG a.word structures
does_not_apply_when: the page has no source-native word-class structure
the ordinal grammar is malformed or incomplete

frozen_relation.popup_node: span element under document-view with class tokens popup and word
frozen_relation.svg_reference_node: a element with class token word descending from svg under the same document-view container
required_invariants: every popup node has one regex-valid ordinal
every SVG word-reference node has one regex-valid ordinal
the two ordinal sets are exactly equal
the two ordinal sequences in DOM order are exactly equal

connection_to_sigla_native_word_view_pro.relationship: The independent word-view probe observed word detail routes /index-word-{ordinal}.html and sign-ID sequence-search anchors. This contract independently validates the DOM ordinal relation on 19 frozen capability-positive pages without extracting literal transcription payload.
connection_to_sigla_native_word_view_pro.important_separation: The route/ordinal relation identifies a technical source-native unit reference. The sign-ID sequence payload used for scientific word identity remains a separately gated parser concern.

parser_integrity_use.recommended_gate: Before a capability-positive page contributes SigLA-native word identities to claim-bearing scoring, the parsed scientific word count and ordinal coverage should be cross-checked against this source-native unit-reference contract.
parser_integrity_use.integration_rule: Add a separately frozen preflight/augmentation gate rather than mutating the already frozen R3A_4 blind-role discovery specification.

forbidden: do not call the ordinal relation independent linguistic word-boundary validation
do not infer semantics from ordinal identity
do not infer popup-left ↔ even or popup-right ↔ odd
do not fabricate word units on capability-negative pages
do not normalize malformed ordinals into compliance
do not use this L1 shared-transcription source as external transcription replication

next_gate.goal: Freeze a preflight that cross-checks the claim-bearing SigLA seq-pattern parser against source-native reported word count and, where available, this strict ordinal unit-reference relation, while retaining valid zero-word/capability-negative documents and without changing the frozen scientific scoring thresholds.
